headline: Commission picks top-ranked finalist as new DPS director

meeting.summary: The Civil Service Commission voted to appoint its top-ranked finalist as DPS director, with the offer pending a background check.
meeting.recap: The Civil Service Commission reconvened a meeting that had been recessed on October 7.[[0:00:41]] The meeting's purpose was to choose a new director of DPS.[[0:02:28]] The commission received 17 applications, with identifying details removed before review.[[0:04:00]] Each commissioner scored finalists out of 90 points, for a possible total of 450.[[0:06:23]] The top-ranked finalist received 378 of 450 points and ranked first overall.[[0:07:46]] A commissioner moved to appoint the top-ranked finalist as director, and Commissioner Lee seconded.[[0:10:21]] On a roll call vote, the chair announced the vote was unanimous.[[0:12:14]] The chair asked the interim leaders to keep serving until the appointment is final.[[0:14:07]] Legal counsel raised a post-offer background check, a check done after a job offer.[[0:14:59]] Counsel said a recent audit found the county lacked uniform screening and background checks.[[0:16:45]] The interim director said DPS does not currently run background checks.[[0:19:00]] The chair said the job offer stands, pending a successful outcome of that process.[[0:20:12]] The commission voted to have a commissioner lead drafting letters to the finalists and other offices.[[0:23:41]] A commissioner said urgent work lies ahead on vacancies, recruitment, retention and HR reform.[[0:26:24]] The meeting was adjourned by unanimous vote.[[0:30:05]]
decided: The commission approved appointing the top-ranked finalist as the new DPS director on a roll call vote announced as unanimous.
The commission assigned a commissioner to work with legal counsel on drafting letters to the candidates and other offices as required.
The commission voted to adjourn the meeting.
meeting.next: Legal counsel said she can work with the interim director to set up the background check for DPS. A commissioner will lead drafting letters to the selected finalist and the two other finalists. Legal counsel said letters would also go to the mayor's office and the council. Legal counsel said a press release may follow later, after the mayor's office is notified. The interim director and interim deputy director were asked to continue until the final appointment is made. The acting commission secretary will continue until the new director selects a private secretary.
